cv.name: Danielle Whitaker
cv.headline: Property Manager | Multifamily & Mixed-Use | CAM
cv.summary: Property manager with six years running multifamily communities in Central Texas. Back in the industry after a two-year break to care for a family member, with a renewed TREC licence and CAM credential. Strong on resident retention, budgets and vendor management.

experience.title: Property Manager
bullets: Manage a 280-unit Class B multifamily community and a team of seven
Raised occupancy from 89% to 95% within nine months through a renewal and referral program
Prepare the annual operating budget and monthly variance reports for ownership
Oversee make-ready turns, vendor contracts and capital projects including a roof replacement

experience.title: Assistant Property Manager
bullets: Handled leasing, delinquency follow-up and evictions in line with Texas Property Code
Rolled out Yardi Breeze for online payments and maintenance requests

experience.title: Leasing Consultant
bullets: Led tours and closed leases; top leasing consultant in the portfolio in 2018

certifications: Texas Real Estate Sales Agent Licence (TREC)
